note: Stable C ABI for non-JVM hosts: new `ffi` feature (vespera / vespera_inprocess). `vespera::ffi_app!(create_app)` / `ffi_apps!{...}` export `vespera_init`; the cdylib also exports `vespera_dispatch`, `vespera_dispatch_into` (direct write, overflow reports the required size), `vespera_dispatch_async` (completion callback), `vespera_free`, `vespera_shutdown` and `vespera_abi_version`, declared in the hand-written header `crates/vespera_inprocess/include/vespera.h`. Panics never unwind across the ABI. The shared host runtime lifecycle moved from vespera_jni into `vespera_inprocess::runtime` (feature `runtime`) so JNI and C hosts share one runtime; vespera_jni re-exports it unchanged.
